name: CFG-Cache (FasterCache, frequency reuse)
plain: Skips the negative pass on some steps: rebuilds it from the positive and cached frequency differences, separately for low and high frequency.
math:
Refresh: DL,DH=low/high(F(u)−F(c))
Reuse: û = IFFT(F(c)+w₁DL+w₂DH); x̂=û+w(c−û)
w₁=1+α_l[t>t₀]; w₂=1+α_h[t≤t₀]

providers.author: AbstractEyes
